1. My first space

My first space : Kitchen Sink

Created by John Briggs, last modified on Aug 10, 2026

This space is a deliberate "kitchen sink" of Confluence content types, used to generate a real HTML space export for testing the https://github.com/jdeb9/confluence-to-markdown converter against spec-driven development test fixtures.

Export this space via https://briggsyj.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/exportspacewelcome.action?key=MFS, then run it through yarn start in the confluence-to-markdown repo.

Test pages

  • Text Formatting — headings, inline styles, blockquotes, status lozenges, placeholders

  • Lists & Tasks — ordered/unordered/nested lists, task lists, decision lists

  • Tables — basic, colored-cell, merged-cell, and wide tables

  • Code & Panels — fenced code blocks, info/note/success/warning/error panels, expand sections

  • Links & Media — external/internal/inline-card links, mentions, dates, an externally-linked image

  • Layouts — multi-column layouts, with a nested child page three levels deep to test page hierarchy

Known gaps

Built via the Atlassian API, which has two limitations worth knowing about before you treat this as a complete fixture set: it cannot upload real file attachments (so there are no true inline image/file attachments, only one externally-hosted linked image), and mailto: links get silently stripped to plain text. Add these by hand in the editor if you need that coverage.
